name: parked-template-catalogue
body: RESOLVED (removed) [with user]: the concrete EY template catalogue is no longer part of eypres in any form. All current EY templates (title/content/column), the EY theme.css, EY fonts and logos are deleted from the codebase entirely — there is no in-repo EY library and no migration into an example/testdata project. EY (or anyone) authors its own `templates/` library outside this repo. The in-repo template content is limited to the unbranded `hello` init seed (cli-init-minimal-seed) and the unbranded demo project `examples/demo/` (demo-project).
